verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's pricing docs say new users automatically get a 7-day Free Trial without a credit card. After the trial, a Lite plan also needs no credit card and includes 10 GB of free storage plus free monthly compute. The getting-started docs promise users can sign up and start querying in minutes, and loading your own data is documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the no-card signup, and documented exact free compute limits and an explicit statement that no sales contact is required.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can evaluate with a free tier or trial — real queries on real data without a credit card or a sales call
